text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: "Falcoooo!! Congratulations!"

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Take 1st place next time too! Run right 
through 'em!"

Smart Falcon brilliantly claimed her third 
target race victory. The crowd's cheers 
grew louder and louder. However...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ――...Stage left, stage right, center.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Thanks☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Thank youuu☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, everyone☆ Please keep 
supporting Falco from here on out too!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Waaaaah! Falco! Falco! Falco...!

text_block_list.name: Falco's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, we definitely gotta go watch the 
Champions Cup too!

text_block_list.name: Falco's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Of course! We're aiming for front-row dead 
center! Let's bear witness to Falco's 
legend!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
—The flash report is out! Today's 
attendance beat last year and set an 
all-time record!
choice_data_list: We're dominating the trends online too!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: What place?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Trending! On Umatter, right? What rank is 
it at!?

I showed the screen displaying the current 
trends.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"...1st through 7th place! And there's a 
bunch of others placed further down, too!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Impressions of today's stage are already 
at... around 8,000 comments? Looks like 
it'll keep growing!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I also need to check the official share 
count. And then the number of articles—
choice_data_list: Don't you want to check the feedback?
Aren't you going to check the feedback?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ah, yeah... I'll be sure to check it 
later, okay?

After that, Smart Falcon spent some time 
checking the massive buzz surrounding 
today's race...

On the way back. Almost as if to prove 
that the buzz surrounding her was growing—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Smart Falcon-san! Hey camera, shoot, 
shoot!
(Click-click-click!)

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
That was a wonderful race, and an amazing 
stage today!

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
Next is finally the Champions Cup! There 
are no blind spots on your path to 
becoming the absolute ruler of dirt!

text_block_list.name: Falco's Fan A
text_block_list.text: "Falcooo!! That was the best live ever!"

text_block_list.name: Falco's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
You're the star of the dirt... no, the 
goddess of racing! You've got to win the 
next one too!
(Waa, waa...)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: —...So dazzling.
choice_data_list: Excuse me, please let me through!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Wait, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...Thanks so much for all the attention, 
everyone☆ Falco is super duper happy♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Please keep on supporting your absolute 
center, Falco, okay~?

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Oooooh! Do your best~~!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
—Haaah~. Falco's truly become a super 
popular Umadol!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'm totally fine! A true Umadol has to be 
able to handle surprise fan service with 
ease☆

text_block_list.name: Twintail Girl
text_block_list.text: Look! Mommy, it's that big sister!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? Wait, isn't that girl...

text_block_list.name: Twintail Girl
text_block_list.text:
Big sis, you were always singing songs, 
weren't you? I was cheering for you the 
whole time!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Good evening☆ Are you with your mommy 
today?

text_block_list.name: Twintail Girl
text_block_list.text: Yeah! We went out on an outing!

text_block_list.name: Girl's Mom
text_block_list.text:
Um, you've been on TV a lot lately, 
haven't you? This little one is always 
glued to the screen watching Falco-san.

text_block_list.name: Twintail Girl
text_block_list.text:
I love big sis's singing! And your dancing 
is so sparkly and pretty too!

text_block_list.name: Twintail Girl
text_block_list.text:
I want to sparkle bright just like you, 
Big Sis!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Sparkly...?

text_block_list.name: Twintail Girl
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Big Sis is always smiling 
and sparkling, after all!

text_block_list.name: Twintail Girl
text_block_list.text:
That's why I put tons of sparkly stickers 
on the letter too! It was super sparkly, 
wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Girl's Mom
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, aren't we done for now? See, Big Sis 
is tired too, so how about we say bye-bye 
here?

text_block_list.name: Twintail Girl
text_block_list.text: Bye-bye, Big Sister!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Bye-bye☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I wonder... Is Falco really shining bright 
right now?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ah, umm... It's nothing!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Aah, ouch-ouch-ouch☆ All that exhaustion 
just hit me out of nowhere! I need to take 
a bath right away!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Well then, good night!

"I really should face Smart Falcon and 
talk to her properly."

—Before the next target race, the 
'Champions Cup'.
